## Smarter Tools. Increased Case Value.

##### 01

### Insight-Rich Medical Chronologies

**LawPro.ai generates structured, searchable medical chronologies for every case—no manual highlighting, no outsourced summaries.** Records are extracted, organized, and summarized into a clean, chronological view that helps you see the full picture fast.

##### 02

### Case Assistant: Your On-Demand Legal Extension

**Embedded in every LawPro case file, Case Assistant is a conversational AI tool that gives you real-time answers about your case, straight from the medical record.** Prep for depositions, speak confidently to adjusters, or generate injury claim letters without toggling tabs or reading hundreds of pages.
